info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Delete Notification Subscriptions Webhook By Webhook Id-v5-spec
info.description: This API allows clients to manage notification subscriptions by facilitating the removal of specific webhook subscriptions using their unique identifiers. Users can delete subscriptions that are no longer needed, enabling efficient management of event notifications and reducing unnecessary traffic. Typical consumers of this API include developers and system administrators who handle integrations with various services that rely on webhook notifications. Utilizing this API helps maintain a clean and relevant notification system for applications.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to delete a specific webhook identified by its unique resource ID. Deleting a webhook will stop any further notifications from being sent to the associated URL.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details required for deleting the webhook associated with the identifier 'RES-100045'. Ensure that you include any necessary parameters that indicate which webhook to remove.

204.description: Request completed successfully with no content returned.

DeleteNotificationSubscriptionsWebhookBy.description: This schema represents the request body for the DELETE operation associated with the webhook. It is expected to be a string that may contain relevant information related to the deletion request.

DeleteNotificationSubscriptionsWebhookBy.title: Webhook Delete Response
DeleteNotificationSubscriptionsWebhookBy.description: This schema represents the response body for a successful DELETE operation on the webhook resource.

x-endpoint-id.description: Unique identifier for the webhook endpoint that processed the request.

x-runtime-app.description: Name of the application that generated the webhook response.
